results.title: Polish PM Donald Tusk Pays Tribute to Mahatma Gandhi
results.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk paid floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at Rajghat in New Delhi, honouring the global legacy of peace and non-violence.

results.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Accused practised shooting near Mumbai before attack, bullet hit bed during accidental discharge in Andheri hotel room
results.description: Following the alarming shooting incident involving Tiger Shroff, authorities have apprehended multiple suspects. Investigations revealed a nearby location in Mumbai where these individuals honed their shooting skills. The police are now exploring potential ties between the arrested parties and the incident itself. Furthermore, an audio recording containing a threatening message aimed at Shroff is set to undergo voice verification analysis as part of this thorough investigation.

results.title: What is GRAP 1? How Delhi-NCR’s pollution curbs could affect employers and employees
results.description: As Delhi-NCR activates GRAP 1 following a sharp rise in pollution, here is what the restrictions mean for office hours, employee commutes, work-from-home arrangements and employers.
